title: OL 9 groups must have unique Group ID (GID).
check_content:
Verify that OL 9 contains no duplicate GIDs for interactive users with the following command:
 
$  cut -d : -f 3 /etc/group | uniq -d
 
If the system has duplicate GIDs, this is a finding.
fixtext: Edit the file "/etc/group" and provide each group that has a duplicate GID with a unique GID.
VulnDiscussion: To ensure accountability and prevent unauthenticated access, groups must be identified uniquely to prevent potential misuse and compromise of the system.
